emma: Quick flag: saw ~18% drop in tokens/sec on p4d for INT8 + KV-warmed runs vs FP16 baseline. FP16 baseline ~1250 toks/s, INT8 ~1025 toks/s with ctx=4096 and kernel-policy=auto.
maria: can you paste the exact bench command + model + quant args?
emma: bench command I used:
```
./bench_tool --model=rw-34b --quant=int8 --kernel-policy=auto --batch-size=4 --context=4096 --warmup-tokens=512 --measure-tokens=1000 --powercap=250
```
raj: auto policy often picks a fallback fused path once KV hit rate crosses a threshold. That fallback can introduce extra memcopies / syncs. Also tile/tiling choices after calibration can flip which kernel is chosen.
oliver: dry checklist for repro: 1) force kernel variants (force-int8, force-fp8, force-4bit, force-fp16) 2) run cold vs warmed KV 3) deterministic tokenization and prompt order 4) capture KERNEL_CHOOSER_TRACE and nsys traces for slow cases.
maria: use deterministic tokenizer: `tools/tokenize_hash.py --seed 7` and the canonical prompt set `--prompt-set real-user-1000.json` so batch composition is identical across modes.
emma: proposed canonical bench steps (please ack):
- powercap: fixed 250W (CI p4d config)
- warmup: 1024 tokens per worker
- measure: 2000 tokens per run
- batch sizes: [1,2,4] (run each)
- kernel modes: force-int8, force-fp8, force-4bit, fp16 baseline (kernel-policy=force)
- KV modes: cold (no cache), warmed (preload 2x warmup length)
- env: `export REDWOOD_PREFETCH=0` and `export CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` for debug reproducibility
- metrics to record: tokens/sec, mean/p95/p99 latency, kernel-selection counts, per-kernel time breakdown, nvprof/nsys for one slow run
raj: also include calibration toggles: run with calibration tables enabled vs disabled. If calibration shifts scale distributions, it may change tiling decisions. Collect histograms of chosen tile sizes and kernel variants.
oliver: I'll add a minimal nightly CI job under eng-runtime/quant-nightly that runs a warmed/cold quick matrix on p4d (single batch-size, smaller measure) and uploads artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/quant/nightly/<ts>. Gate it to p4d runners only.
emma: I'll update `bench_tool` to emit `kernel_time.csv` and `kv_metrics.json` per run (artifact formats are fine outside this doc). Also will include a `chooser_trace.log` when `KERNEL_CHOOSER_TRACE=1`.
maria: for fair comparisons: same prompt order, deterministic tokenization, identical batch composition, and identical sampling seeds. Do not mix synthetic prompts with real prompt-set in the same comparison.
raj: hypothesis: chooser cost model undervalues copy/synchronization overhead when KV is hot, so it prefers an algorithm with fewer FLOPs but more memcopies leading to stalls. Calibration changes could alter memory layout estimates and flip the decision boundary.
emma: repro timeline: I'll run the forced-kernel matrix and upload CSV + chooser logs today to s3://redwood-perf/quant_regress/1718205555/ and paste links here when done.
ci-bot: scheduled job: eng-runtime/quant-nightly started at 1718205600
oliver: thanks — ping me when traces + artifacts land; I'll extract the heaviest-run nsys profile and look at stream waits and kernel overlap.
emma: if we confirm a chooser bug I'll open a regression ticket, attach chooser traces + nsys flame, and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml for root-cause. :thumbsup:
